copy_failures.title: HyProMag USA Pre-Feasibility Study Outlines Future Expansion Options to Quadruple Planned U.S. Rare Earth Magnet Capacity Indicating an Incremental Post-Tax NPV of up to US$2.1 Billion - Yahoo Finance

rejected_copy.summary_en: HyProMag USA completed an independent pre-feasibility study by PegasusTSI Inc. and BBA USA Inc. evaluating a three-plant expansion and a centralized finishing hub. The study indicates an incremental post-tax net present value of US$1.85 billion to US$2.06 billion and a post-tax internal rate of return of 31% to 36%.
rejected_copy.summary_ko: 미국 희토류 자석 공장 확장 사전타당성조사 완료 - HyProMag USA는 PegasusTSI Inc.와 BBA USA Inc.의 사전타당성조사를 통해 신규 공장 3곳과 중앙 허브 확장 시 세후 NPV 18억 5,400만~20억 6,200만 달러 및 세후 IRR 31~36%가 도출되었다고 밝혔음.
